name: Kirishima Umeko
source: The mother of the Kirishima siblings. She rarely makes an appearance though she does sometimes. She's happy when she learns [url=/c42534]Yuuki[/url] got one of his sisters pregnant because it means they can marry their brother and won't leave the house to find a boyfriend. She then encourages the other sisters to get pregnant and marry their brother too so they can continue living together as a family.
